text:
Leah T.: After today's pm review, I'd like to propose a small set of concrete changes: a compact timeline template for follow-ups, a clear comms beat, and a paired IC rotation.

Omar H.: Sounds good. What does the timeline template look like?

Leah T.: Minimal timeline (copy-able):

```
T0 = Incident closed
T+48h = Owner assigned + ack
T+7d = Status update emailed to stakeholders
T+30d = Verification + evidence posted
T+90d = Recurrence check + closure note
```

Priya N.: I like the clarity. Can we add a small "what success looks like" line per action so closure isn't subjective?

Noah - oncall: yes. propose a one-line AcceptanceCriteria column for each action. Also suggest a two-person IC pairing model: primary IC rotates weekly, secondary shadow rotates on a separate cadence to ensure handover.

oncall-bot: [automated] I can create reminders at T+48h, T+7d, T+30d, and T+90d. Configure channels_to_notify and reminder_offsets.

Leah T.: For comms cadence: initial PM summary within 24h (email + thread), progress email at 7d, final closure note at 30d. If an action remains open at 90d, send an executive ping with mitigation plan.

Omar H.: How do we detect recurrence patterns? Manual tagging is noisy. Maybe auto-suggest tags by matching service paths and error signatures across incidents. Flag candidates that appear in >=2 incidents in 60 days for review.

Priya N.: +1. Also include a "heat" column on the timeline that scores recurrence risk (low/med/high) so triage focuses on systemic work.

Noah - oncall: Implementation plan: 1) add the template to postmortem checklist, 2) oncall-bot configured to post reminders and create follow-up issues for SLAs >72h, 3) pair IC rotation: weekly primary + biweekly secondary shadow.

Leah T.: For ownership: require owner ack in-thread or via issue assignment within 48h. If no ack, oncall-bot will escalate to team lead and assign temporary owner.

oncall-bot: [automated] Escalation policy set: ack_window_hours=48, escalate_to=[team_lead, oncall]. Weekly digest posted Fridays 08:00 UTC.

Omar H.: Let's pilot this on incidents closed in the next month. Metrics to track: percent of actions with acceptance criteria, 7/30/90 closure rates, and number of recurrences flagged by the auto-suggester.

Priya N.: I can own the dashboard for these metrics and run a 6-week review at the end of the pilot.

Noah - oncall: I'll add the timeline template to the postmortem doc and wire the bot. ETA: next Monday (1853270000). Adding the paired rotation invites to the calendar now.

Leah T.: Thanks team. If folks want to shape the template, edit the doc I just added to the postmortem folder. Tag @Noah when you update. :rocket:
